name: Life is difficult
original_name: Hachaim he tkufa kasha (החיים הם תקופה קשה)
overview: Life is a hard time is an Israeli comedy drama series based on the book of the same name by Hanoch Daum, who created and wrote the series together with Omri Amit and Ader Mirom. The series deals with the life of Daum and his family in the Abinadav settlement and the complexities he faces. The series is broadcast starting on September 23, 2024 on demand 12.
